title: Agent Store plugin manifest
description: `.codebuddy-plugin/plugin.json` — doc 17 §3 fixes required fields, defaults and the tolerant shapes; doc 02 §4/§5 is the field-level authority. `name` is the ONLY required field (blank counts as missing: import blocks with MissingIdentity). Unknown keys are tolerated, so this schema never rejects a manifest merely for carrying extra fields.

hooks.description: Recorded only — NOT enabled in V1.

lspServers.description: V1 metadata level: server names only, NOT enabled.

userConfig.description: Credential schema; values live in secure storage only.

dependencies.description: Array of entries, or an object keyed by dependency kind (grouped form).

channels.description: Enablement metadata; doc 17 §3 fixes no type.

defaultEnabled.description: Install/enable policy metadata; doc 17 §3 fixes no type.

strict.description: true requires the plugin source to carry its own plugin.json.

identity.description: Only required field. Whitespace-only is treated as missing (import blocks with MissingIdentity).

localized.description: Display metadata: a plain string, or an object keyed by language.

localizedList.description: A localized value, or a list of them.

stringOrList.description: Single string and array are both accepted (`"./agents/"` or `["./agents/a.md"]`).

relativePath.description: Path relative to the market/plugin root: no absolute or UNC path, no `..` segment, no backslash. Applies to `avatar` (doc 17 §3) and to entry `source` (doc 18 §4).
